title: Sum of the valid integers
prompt:
Read lines from standard input. A line is a valid integer if, after removing the spaces and tabs at its start and end, it is an optional minus sign followed by one or more decimal digits (a plus sign, a decimal point or any other character makes it invalid; `-` alone is invalid, and so is `1 2`).

Lines that are empty after removing spaces and tabs are skipped silently. For every other line that is not a valid integer print `line N: invalid`, where N is the line's position in the input counting from 1 (skipped lines count). After the last line print `sum=S count=C`, where S is the sum of the valid integers and C is how many there were. All values stay far below 2^53 in absolute value.

cases.name: example
cases.expected_output:
line 2: invalid
line 5: invalid
sum=47 count=3

cases.name: hidden2
cases.expected_output:
line 1: invalid
line 2: invalid
line 3: invalid
line 7: invalid
line 8: invalid
